clue.text: Avoids holding appeal backing drug

indicators.note: backing means the whole assembled string is read from right to left
holding means one word wraps around the other

parts.note: to avoid is to evade
IT is sex appeal, as in 'she's got it'

explanation.surface: Someone dodging an appeal against a ruling on a drug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'appeal' is the crossword's IT, sex appeal. 'holding' puts it inside the avoid word to give EVITADES, and 'backing' reads that from the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A sedative is a calming medicine, a type of drug.

clue.text: Drain drink to get title

parts.note: to sip is to drink
Hon, short for Honourable, is a title

explanation.surface: Knocking back a drink to earn a title.
explanation.definitionFit: To siphon liquid is to draw it off through a tube, so to drain it.

clue.text: St Peter maybe the measure of fineness

definitions.meaning: one who denies: Peter denied knowing Jesus three times
the unit grading the thickness of yarn or stockings

explanation.surface: A saint apparently set up as a standard of refinement.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense reads the answer as 'one who denies', with Peter's three denials as the example.
explanation.definitionFit: Peter denied Christ, so he is a denier; denier also grades the thickness of yarn.

clue.text: Money raised by society for idiots

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: loot is slang for money

explanation.surface: A society raising funds for fools.
explanation.definitionFit: A tool is a slang insult for a stupid person, so plural fools.

clue.text: Benefit of vehicle label beginning to emerge

parts.note: a van is a vehicle
a tag is a label

indicators.note: beginning to means just the first letter of emerge

explanation.surface: The advantage of a vehicle's label starting to show.
explanation.definitionFit: A vantage is an advantage or favourable position, hence a benefit.

clue.text: Surgeons maybe in charge after sea storm's onset

indicators.note: after places the in-charge piece behind the sea piece

parts.note: MED is short for the Mediterranean Sea

indicators.note: onset means the first letter of the word storm

explanation.surface: Doctors arriving at sea once a storm breaks.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons are an example of medical practitioners, hence 'maybe'.

clue.text: Notorious European pie maker losing final grand keeping promise

indicators.note: keeping means the outer letters hold the promise inside
losing final means the last of the grand letters goes

parts.note: Greggs is a British bakery chain known for pies and pasties
G is slang for a grand, a thousand pounds
an IOU is a written promise to pay

explanation.surface: A notorious baker from Europe failing in the end yet keeping a promise.
explanation.walkthrough: Greggs is a British high-street bakery chain famed for pies. 'losing final' drops its second G to leave GREGS, which then wraps the promise.
explanation.definitionFit: Egregious means outstandingly bad, close to notorious or infamous.

clue.text: Unfriendly but fashionable one goes to show without us

parts.note: in means fashionable
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: without means the letters of us are removed

parts.note: a musical is a stage show

explanation.surface: A cold person who goes to a trendy show but leaves us behind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without us' takes the U and S out of MUSICAL, leaving MICAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Inimical means hostile or harmful, the opposite of friendly.

clue.text: Charming ape chewed plant

parts.note: sweet means charming or delightful

indicators.note: chewed means the word ape is mangled into another order

explanation.surface: A cute ape munching on a flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The sweet pea is a climbing flowering plant grown for its scent.

clue.text: Locate popular naval officer drowning in drink

indicators.note: drowning in means submerged inside the drink, so placed within it

parts.note: a pint is a drink of beer
in means fashionable or popular
PO is a Petty Officer in the navy

explanation.surface: Finding a well-liked sailor who is drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: INPO goes after the P of PINT: P-INPO-INT.
explanation.definitionFit: To pinpoint something is to find its exact position, a synonym.

clue.text: Plots out loud to cause injury

indicators.note: out loud says the word is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: someone who brews trouble plots it

explanation.surface: Conspirators speaking openly about harming someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To bruise is to hurt or damage, a verb sense of harming.

clue.text: Starters of marinated eel sushi served in dining room

indicators.note: starters of means the first letters of the next four words

explanation.surface: A menu of Japanese appetisers served in a dining room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Starters' pretends to be the first course, but it picks first letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A mess is a communal eating hall, especially in the armed forces.

clue.text: Exaggerate past situation

parts.note: over means finished or past
a state is a condition or situation

explanation.surface: Overplaying how bad a past situation was.
explanation.definitionFit: To exaggerate is to claim more than is true, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Bad feeling caused by tip of instrument left in stomach

indicators.note: in places the two letters inside the stomach word

parts.note: gut means stomach

indicators.note: tip of means the first letter of instrument

explanation.surface: A surgical instrument left inside a patient brings bad feelings.
explanation.definitionFit: Remorse for wrongdoing is an unpleasant emotion, hence a bad feeling.

clue.text: Weak, shiny fabric

definitions.meaning: feeble, unconvincing, as in a feeble excuse
a glittering cloth woven with metallic threads, used for evening wear

explanation.surface: A description of a flimsy, glittering cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: A feeble excuse is a lame one; lamé is cloth woven with metal threads.

clue.text: Reconciled with people having time to make amends

parts.note: at one means reconciled or in agreement
men are people

explanation.surface: Reconciled with others, someone takes time to make up for things.
explanation.definitionFit: Atonement is reparation for a wrong, the same sense as making amends.

clue.text: Way to love fashion in Warehouse

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
the rage is the current fashion

explanation.surface: Seemingly about the Warehouse fashion chain and how it treats love.
explanation.walkthrough: Warehouse is a British fashion retailer, which makes the capitalised word look like a shop name.
explanation.definitionFit: A warehouse is a place for keeping goods, as is a depot used for keeping things.

clue.text: Unwilling guests of entertainer grow old and start to shrivel

parts.note: a host entertains guests
to age is to grow old

indicators.note: start to means the first letter of shrivel

explanation.surface: A party host ageing and shrivelling in front of reluctant visitors.
explanation.definitionFit: Captives held against their will are, wryly, guests who did not choose to stay.

clue.text: Offer daughter iced-tea concoction

indicators.note: a concoction is a mixture, so the drink's letters are mixed

explanation.surface: Offering one's daughter a homemade iced-tea mix.
explanation.definitionFit: To dedicate something is to devote or offer it, as a book to a person.

clue.text: Demanding I wake without drug

parts.note: the numeral I is one

indicators.note: without means the drug letter is taken away

parts.note: to rouse is to wake
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Someone insisting on waking up without medication.
explanation.definitionFit: Onerous tasks are heavy and burdensome, so they are demanding.

clue.text: Problem arising in Glamorganshire

indicators.note: arising in a down clue means the letters read upwards, so backwards
in means the letters sit inside the county name

explanation.surface: Trouble breaking out in a Welsh county.
explanation.walkthrough: Glamorgan is a historic county in south Wales. 'in' finds GANS inside it and 'arising' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: A snag is an unexpected difficulty or hitch.

clue.text: Defeat left horses missing odd bits

indicators.note: missing odd bits means dropping the first, third and fifth letters so only the even ones remain

explanation.surface: A racing setback: a loss after horses fail to show.
explanation.definitionFit: A loss is a defeat in a contest, a synonym.

clue.text: Held up crossing river in can

indicators.note: crossing means the outer word spans across the other letters

parts.note: held up means delayed, so late

explanation.surface: Someone delayed at a river crossing while in a can.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' is slang for a toilet, mainly American.
explanation.definitionFit: Can is slang for a toilet, and a latrine is a basic toilet.

clue.text: Give fellow a note

parts.note: a don is a university fellow
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Handing a man a banknote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note' suggests money, but it is a musical note.
explanation.definitionFit: To donate is to give, especially to charity.

clue.text: Remove permit to enter river

indicators.note: to enter means the permit word goes inside the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
to let is to permit

explanation.surface: Revoking a licence to go into a river.
explanation.definitionFit: To delete is to erase or take out, so remove.

clue.text: Journey to East is rubbish

parts.note: a trip is a journey

explanation.surface: A verdict that a trip to the East was dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe, beyond the food, means nonsense or worthless stuff.

clue.text: Skill I suppress growing vegetable

parts.note: art means skill, as in the art of conversation
to choke back is to suppress

explanation.surface: A gardener holding back their talent as a vegetable grows.
explanation.definitionFit: An artichoke is a plant grown for food, an example of a vegetable.

clue.text: Croatia's foremost port is Split

indicators.note: foremost means the first letter of Croatia

parts.note: port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: A travel fact: Split is Croatia's leading port.
explanation.walkthrough: Split is a Croatian port city, so it looks like part of the scene, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Cleft is a past form of cleave, meaning divided or split.

clue.text: Try a support for facial hair

parts.note: to have a go is to try
a tee supports a golf ball

explanation.surface: Advice to give some backing to a beard.
explanation.definitionFit: A goatee is a small chin beard, a kind of facial hair.

clue.text: The Italian returning censure free

indicators.note: returning means the Italian article is read backwards

parts.note: il is the Italian for 'the'
to berate is to scold or censure

explanation.surface: An Italian coming back to criticise freely.
explanation.definitionFit: To liberate is to set free, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Trim so veil extends lower than eyes to start with

indicators.note: to start with means take the opening letter of each of these six words

explanation.surface: A fashion note about a veil reaching down past the eyes.
explanation.definitionFit: Svelte means slim and elegant, so trim in figure.

clue.text: Dilettante man inhabits decaying estate

indicators.note: inhabits means the man lives inside the other letters
decaying means the estate falls apart into a new order

parts.note: he is a man

explanation.surface: A dabbler living in a crumbling country house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'decaying' rearranges the property word into AESTTE, and the man settles into the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: An aesthete is a lover of art and beauty, roughly a dilettante or amateur connoisseur.
